On multiple occasions, I have been met with dismissive and confrontational behavior when asking simple questions. This has included sighing, scoffing, speaking very loudly over me, and being told that they are too busy to provide a proper response. On one occasion, the interaction was so upsetting that it left me in tears, which made an already stressful situation much worse.

For example, when I asked if my GP would read a letter, the response I received felt dismissive and didn’t address my question. Additionally, I often find that the answers given are unrelated to what I’ve asked, leaving me confused and without the necessary information.

I truly understand the immense pressure the NHS is under, and I am always respectful and aim to be accommodating when I call.
